notes.basis: Population is the decennial census count: 2010 Census for elections through 2020, 2020 Census from 2022. Eligible citizens are the citizen voting-age population from the ACS special tabulation: 2014-2018 for elections through 2020, 2019-2023 from 2022. Electoral votes follow the 2010 apportionment for 2016-2020 and the 2020 apportionment from 2022.
notes.CT: The 2019-2023 tabulation uses Connecticut's nine planning regions, which do not nest in the eight historic counties used here; the state total is shared among the counties by their 2020 Census population 18+.
notes.AK: Alaska reports by House district, not by county, so it is not on the county maps. Where its certified statewide total is at hand (president 2016-2024; Senate 2020, 2022 and 2026, the last unofficial), it counts as one unit in the state figures and the national totals; governor races have no Alaska total here, so for them it is left out.
notes.fold: Shannon County SD (46113) is Oglala Lakota (46102); Falls Church city is counted with Fairfax County and Bedford city with Bedford County, as in the vote data.
notes.senate_governor: For Senate and governor races the national averages are over the states with a race.

AK.source: https://www.fec.gov/documents/5676/federalelections2022.xlsx (first-choice general votes; the race was decided by ranked choice)
